main_body: A palm tree: a curved segmented tan trunk rising to a green frond canopy with drooping fronds.
top_band: none; the trunk reads as a vertical curved cylinder and the canopy is a frond mass seen from the side/above, with no distinct top band over a front face
evidence: Organic palm tree. The trunk is a thin curved tan column with ring segments and a dark brown outline; the canopy is a fan of fronds with lighter green highlights near the centre. There is no rigid top/front structure to measure. As an organic plant, the canopy gives volume from above with drooping fronds, but the silhouette is essentially a side view of a palm. Pixel column through the middle: bright green fronds (rows ~2-14), then trunk tan (rows ~14-40). The canopy is not a clear top band over a front face, so strictly it does not match the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The palm has about 4 green steps on the fronds (light yellow-green highlight to dark green) and 3-4 tan steps on the trunk with dark brown ring shading. Outlines are dark brown on the trunk and dark green on the fronds, which are tinted rather than black. Texture is modest: the frond clumps are blocky with some highlights, and the trunk has ring banding but little grain. It is clearly simpler and less leafy than the reference trees, which have many leaf clumps in several greens and rich trunk and root detail. There are no big flat fills, but density per tile is lower than the references, so it falls short of the Beodeul bar.
